actions.label: Add to list
actions.description: Add an item to your shopping list.
actions.agent: Add or restore one item on the person's shopping list. It adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

name.label: Item
name.description: What to buy, such as eggs or flour.
name.ask: What should I add to your shopping list?

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: How many or how much, as a number above 0. Leave it out when it doesn't matter.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams, cups or cans. Leave it out for a plain count.

categoryKey.label: Category
categoryKey.description: Optional. The aisle's category key, such as produce or pantry.

iconKey.label: Icon
iconKey.description: Optional. The item's icon key, such as wheat or package.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the item is added once.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose list, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts on their own list.

actions.label: Get shopping list
actions.description: See your shopping list.
actions.agent: Fetch the configured owner shopping list.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

actions.label: Search shopping list
actions.description: Find items on your shopping list.
actions.agent: Full-text search the configured owner's private shopping list by ingredient, unit, category, icon, and checked state. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

query.label: Search
query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

actions.label: Check shopping-list item
actions.description: Tick an item off your shopping list, or put it back.
actions.agent: Set checked state for one active item on the configured owner shopping list.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

checked.label: Checked
checked.description: True to check the item off, false to uncheck it.

actions.label: Remove shopping-list item
actions.description: Take an item off your shopping list.
actions.agent: Soft-remove one item from the configured owner shopping list.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

actions.label: Add recipe to shopping list
actions.description: Add a recipe's ingredients to your shopping list.
actions.agent: Add all ingredients from a recipe to the configured owner shopping list. Each ingredient adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: The recipe whose ingredients to add, by id.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the items are added once.

actions.label: List cookbooks
actions.description: See your cookbooks.
actions.agent: List cookbooks owned by the configured owner, with active recipe counts and covers.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

query.label: Search
query.description: Only cookbooks whose title has these words.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

actions.label: Get cookbook
actions.description: Open one of your cookbooks.
actions.agent: Fetch one cookbook owned by the configured owner by cookbookId or exact title.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbookId.label: Cookbook
cookbookId.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.label: Title
title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbookTitle.label: Cookbook title
cookbookTitle.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

actions.label: Create cookbook
actions.description: Start a new cookbook.
actions.agent: Create or return an existing cookbook for the configured owner by exact title.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

title.label: Title
title.description: The cookbook's title; an existing cookbook with this exact title is returned instead.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Stable key (8-100 letters, digits, '_' or '-') for replay-safe creation: a repeat with the same key returns the cookbook the first call made, with created: true and mutation.replayed: true.

actions.label: Add recipe to cookbook
actions.description: Save a recipe in one of your cookbooks.
actions.agent: Idempotently add an active recipe to a cookbook owned by the configured owner.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbookId.label: Cookbook
cookbookId.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.label: Title
title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbookTitle.label: Cookbook title
cookbookTitle.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

actions.label: Remove recipe from cookbook
actions.description: Take a recipe out of one of your cookbooks.
actions.agent: Idempotently remove a recipe from a cookbook owned by the configured owner.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbookId.label: Cookbook
cookbookId.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.label: Title
title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbookTitle.label: Cookbook title
cookbookTitle.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

actions.label: Log a cook
actions.description: Log that you cooked a recipe, with a note and a photo.
actions.agent: Create a RecipeSpoon (cook event) authored by the authenticated principal.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: The recipe that was cooked, by id.

photoUrl.label: Photo
photoUrl.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_spoon_photo.

nextTime.label: Next time
nextTime.description: What to do differently next time.

cookedAt.label: Cooked
cookedAt.description: When it was cooked, as an ISO date-time; now when left out.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Stable key (8-100 letters, digits, '_' or '-') for replay-safe creation: a repeat with the same key returns the spoon the first call made instead of logging a second cook.

actions.label: Update a cook
actions.description: Change a cook you logged.
actions.agent: Update note, nextTime, photoUrl, or cookedAt on a spoon owned by the authenticated principal.

nextTime.label: Next time
nextTime.description: What to do differently next time.

photoUrl.label: Photo
photoUrl.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_spoon_photo, or null to remove the photo.

cookedAt.label: Cooked
cookedAt.description: When it was cooked, as an ISO date-time; now when left out.

actions.label: Delete a cook
actions.description: Delete a cook you logged.
actions.agent: Soft-delete a spoon owned by the authenticated principal.

actions.label: List cooks for recipe
actions.description: See who has cooked a recipe.
actions.agent: List the most-recent non-deleted spoons for a recipe.

actions.label: List cooks by chef
actions.description: See what a chef has cooked.
actions.agent: List the chef's most-recent non-deleted spoons across all recipes.

actions.label: Upload spoon photo
actions.description: Add a photo of something you cooked.
actions.agent: Upload a spoon/cook photo from base64 bytes and return a Spoonjoy image URL for spoon assignment.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

filename.label: File name
filename.description: The photo's file name, such as dinner.jpg.

actions.label: List recipe covers
actions.description: See a recipe's cover photos.
actions.agent: List Recipe Photo Studio cover candidates. Owners with kitchen write access receive full cover history; other readers receive active public cover metadata only. May record that an abandoned generation failed: a cover still processing ten minutes after its generation started is reported, and stored, as failed.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe whose cover candidates should be listed.

includeArchived.label: Include archived
includeArchived.description: Include archived cover candidates in the owner-only history.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of cover candidates to return.

actions.label: List recipe spoon images
actions.description: See the photos from your cooks of a recipe that could be its cover.
actions.agent: List owner-only Spoon photos that can be used as Recipe Photo Studio cover sources.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe whose Spoon photos should be listed.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of Spoon photos to return.

actions.label: Create recipe cover from upload
actions.description: Make a cover for a recipe from a photo you uploaded.
actions.agent: Create a Recipe Photo Studio cover candidate from an uploaded recipe or spoon photo URL.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe that will receive the cover candidate.

imageUrl.label: Photo
imageUrl.description: Spoonjoy uploaded recipe or spoon photo URL to use as the original cover source.

activateWhenReady.label: Use when ready
activateWhenReady.description: Make the cover active when the editorial image is ready.

generateEditorial.label: Editorial
generateEditorial.description: Generate an editorialized cover from the uploaded original photo.

promptAddition.label: Prompt
promptAddition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide editorial cover generation.

postAsSpoon.label: Also log a cook
postAsSpoon.description: Also create a Spoon entry to preserve the original photo with optional cook notes.

note.label: Note
note.description: Spoon note used when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

nextTime.label: Next time
nextTime.description: Spoon next-time note used when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

cookedAt.label: Cooked
cookedAt.description: ISO date-time for the Spoon cook when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for replay-safe cover creation.

dryRun.label: Plan only
dryRun.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

actions.label: Generate recipe cover placeholder
actions.description: Make an AI placeholder cover for a recipe.
actions.agent: Generate an AI placeholder cover candidate for a recipe with an optional prompt addition.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe that will receive the generated AI placeholder cover.

promptAddition.label: Prompt
promptAddition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide AI placeholder generation.

activateWhenReady.label: Use when ready
activateWhenReady.description: Make the generated cover active when the generated cover is ready.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for replay-safe placeholder generation.

dryRun.label: Plan only
dryRun.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

actions.label: Regenerate recipe cover
actions.description: Make a recipe's cover again.
actions.agent: Regenerate the editorial image for a recipe cover candidate with an optional prompt addition.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

promptAddition.label: Prompt
promptAddition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide regenerated editorial output.

activateWhenReady.label: Use when ready
activateWhenReady.description: Make the regenerated cover active when the regenerated cover is ready.

dryRun.label: Plan only
dryRun.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

actions.label: Get cover generation status
actions.description: See whether a recipe's new cover is ready.
actions.agent: Fetch Recipe Photo Studio generation status and active-cover context. May record that an abandoned generation failed: a cover still processing ten minutes after its generation started is reported, and stored, as failed, so polling can stop.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

coverId.label: Cover
coverId.description: Recipe cover candidate whose generation status should be fetched.

actions.label: Set active recipe cover
actions.description: Choose a recipe's cover.
actions.agent: Set one existing Recipe Photo Studio cover variant as the active recipe cover.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

variant.label: Variant
variant.description: Cover variant to activate: image or stylized.

actions.label: Set recipe no cover
actions.description: Show a recipe with no cover.
actions.agent: Set an explicit no-cover state for a recipe after destructive no-cover confirmation.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe that should intentionally display no cover.

confirmNoCover.label: Confirm
confirmNoCover.description: Required explicit confirmation before entering no-cover mode.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for replay-safe no-cover changes.

actions.label: Archive recipe cover
actions.description: Put away one of a recipe's covers.
actions.agent: Archive a Recipe Photo Studio cover. Archiving the active cover requires a replacement or explicit no-cover confirmation.

recipeId.label: Recipe
recipeId.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

replacementCoverId.label: Replacement
replacementCoverId.description: Replacement cover candidate to activate when archiving the active cover.

replacementVariant.label: Variant
replacementVariant.description: Replacement variant to activate: image or stylized.

confirmNoCover.label: No cover
confirmNoCover.description: Use explicit no-cover mode when archiving the active cover without a replacement.

deleteSafeObjects.label: Delete images
deleteSafeObjects.description: Request deletion of safe owned image objects after archive when supported.

actions.label: Approve access
actions.description: Let this agent, app or device use your Spoonjoy account.
actions.agent: Approve a pending agent connection request, which gives that client access to the person's Spoonjoy account.

requestId.label: Request
requestId.description: The connection request's id, from start_agent_connection.

personOnly.reason: You can't approve access to the person's Spoonjoy account; only they can.
personOnly.how: with Approve access on the connection page, after typing the code you showed them
